decisions.reason: As a flagship organic product that remained visible in both 2023 and 2024, it fits the firm's stated direction and still offers strong option value at low continuation cost.
Its visibility slipped from a dedicated page to only a mention by 2024, and as a less strategic non-organic snack it looks like a weaker option than the firm's newer organic launches.
This is a very recent organic line extension in a core sausage category, so uncertainty has not resolved yet and keeping it on the market is a relatively cheap way to learn.
The product is newly launched, offered in two variants, and closely matches the firm's expansion into organic and more ingredient-conscious formats, so management would continue the trial.
This new organic salami variant builds on the firm's core salami expertise, and although demand for the herb-coated niche is still uncertain, it is too early to abandon the option.
